questions.ask: What is your date of birth?
What are the last four digits of the phone number we have on file for you?

hints.day_month_swapped: Could you please say the month as a word?

intents.hardship: The customer mentions illness, a death in the family or job loss.
intents.dispute: "This debt is not mine" or "I never had this product"; a claim that the product was closed or paid off in the past is also a dispute.
intents.already_paid: "I already paid": only a payment of this past-due amount (a past payoff or closure is a dispute).
intents.restructure: A request for a new payment plan or lower instalments.
intents.vague: A vague period such as "next week", "end of the month", "when my salary comes".
intents.too_much: The customer says the full amount is too much.

lines.opening: Hello, I am a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank. We record this call.
lines.robot: I am Freya Bank's digital assistant.
lines.scam: You can verify this call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number.
lines.purpose_before_verify: I can only explain once I have confirmed your identity. The security questions protect your account.
lines.no_info: I'm sorry, I do not have that information.
lines.not_talk_once: I understand. This will only take a moment.
lines.tp_ask_time: Could you suggest another time, today or on the next business day, between 10 am and 7 pm?
lines.tp_outside_window: I'm sorry, I can only arrange a call today or on the next business day, between 10 am and 7 pm.
lines.tp_no_info: I'm sorry, I can only speak with {title} {last_name} about this.
lines.tp_booked: Thank you. We will call back on {date} at {time}.
lines.condolence: I am sorry for your loss.
lines.id_intro: Before we continue, I need to ask you two security questions.
lines.id_explain: I need to make sure I am speaking with the right person. These questions protect your account.
lines.id_declined: I understand. I cannot continue without confirming your identity.
lines.id_repeat: Could you please say that again?
lines.id_wrong: I'm sorry, that does not match our records.
lines.id_failed: I'm sorry, I cannot confirm your identity. Please use the Freya Bank mobile app or visit a branch.
lines.disclose_intro: Thank you. I am calling from the collections team about a late payment.
lines.product_line: Your {name} has {amount} past due, and it is {days} days late.
lines.ask_today: Can you make this payment today?
lines.ask_today_multi: Can you make these payments today?
lines.offer_floor_date: I can record {amount} on {date}. The rest stays overdue. Would that work for you?
lines.offer_floor: I can record {amount}. The rest stays overdue. Would that work for you?
lines.below_floor: I'm sorry, I cannot record that amount. Could you pay {floor}?
lines.below_floor_again: I'm sorry, I cannot record that amount.
lines.date_past: I'm sorry, that date has already passed. The date needs to be today or later.
lines.not_business_day: That day is not a business day. The next business day is {date}. Would that work for you?
lines.after_deadline: The latest date I can record is {date}. Could you pay on {date}?
lines.vague_ask: Which exact day would that be?
lines.ask_date_for_amount: On which day could you pay {amount}?
lines.repeat_offer: To repeat, that is {amount} on {date}. Would that work for you?
lines.clamped_note: For your {name}, the latest date I can accept is {date}.
lines.recorded: Thank you. Your promise is recorded.
lines.sms_line: You will receive a text message confirming this promise.
lines.record_failed: I'm sorry, I could not record your promise.
lines.paid_line: Thank you. Payments can take one business day to appear.
lines.dispute_line: I understand. I will not ask you for a payment on this call.
lines.hardship: I am sorry to hear that. Would you like me to connect you with our customer support team?
lines.restructure_line: I will connect you with a colleague who can discuss that with you.
lines.human_ask_help: Is there anything I can help you with first?
lines.transfer: I am transferring you now. Please hold.
lines.anything_else: Is there anything else I can help you with?
lines.promise_change: I cannot change it on this call, but you can change it in the mobile app.
lines.goodbye: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
lines.confirm_again: Sorry, I did not catch that. Do you confirm, yes or no?
lines.callback_failed: I'm sorry, I could not book the callback.
lines.transfer_failed: I'm sorry, the transfer did not go through.
lines.system_error: I'm sorry, our system is not responding right now.
lines.below_floor_final: I'm sorry, I can't record less than {amount}.

quotes: A flat refusal or a non-answer uses one persuasion attempt. A no to paying today with no date and no amount is a flat refusal.
Attempt 1: propose the last business day of this week.
rules.opening_is_attempt.derivation: A refusal of the opening ask (pay today) uses an attempt, after which attempt 1 is proposed; the opening ask is not itself attempt 1. Early band: 1 proposal after the opening ask; late band: 2.

quotes: If the customer says the full amount is too much, offer the floor, once.
Attempt 2 may name the floor again, on the deadline.
Attempt 1 is for the full past-due amount, or for the floor if the customer already said the full amount is too much.
rules.too_much_floor.derivation: The single floor offer after 'too much' is attempt 1 (on attempt 1's date, using the attempt); attempt 2 names the floor 'again' on the deadline. An extra floor offer on the asked date would break 'once'.

quotes: A flat refusal or a non-answer uses one persuasion attempt.
If the customer refuses the deadline, treat it as a flat refusal (rule 30).
If it fails, try once more.
Offer to connect them with the customer support team.

rules.deadline_adjust.assumption: Deadlines are counted in business days, so they are always business days; default previous_business_day kept. Customer-named weekend/holiday dates get the next business day (rule 20, via not_business_day).

quotes: Ask for the full past-due amount first.
Can you make this payment today?
If today is that day, propose the last business day of next week.
When the attempts are used up, stop.

rules.skipped_repeat_counts.assumption: The brief only says 'Do not repeat an offer the customer already refused.'; it does not say whether a skipped step uses an attempt. Engine default applies.

rules.opening_blocks_repeat.assumption: The brief does not say whether a step equal to the opening ask counts as a repeat; default false.

rules.too_much_skips_full.assumption: Not stated; default false (attempt 1 uses full_or_floor).

products.floor_pct.assumption: The floor is an account field (minimum_payment / instalment_amount), not a percentage.

products.floor_full_below.assumption: No threshold below which the full debt is the floor.

products.floor_round.assumption: No rounding stated; floor taken as given.

products.step_round.assumption: No percentage ladder steps; no rounding.

products.promise_scale.assumption: create_promise takes the same unit as get_account.

products.promise_round.assumption: No rounding rule for promises stated.

multi.outcome_priority.assumption: Brief A covers one product; no ranking.

multi.order.assumption: Brief A covers one product; account order.

assumptions: The brief names no currency; the default 'dollars' is used.
max_unclear is omitted because the brief gives no re-ask count; rule 30 makes a non-answer use one persuasion attempt (non_answer_counts true).
Rule 3: a question from the customer is answered first, and the ask that follows counts as the second ask (confirm.max_asks 2).
Callback: 'today or the next business day, from 10:00 to 19:00, both included, and later than now'; business_days_only is left false because 'today' is not restricted to business days.
Callback max_asks 2: rule 7 asks once more after the first time outside the window, then closes as no_callback.
date_order is dmy per rule 11: 'Read a date given only as numbers as day, then month, then year.'

Rule 26 floor offer after 'too much' (too_much_floor asked_date): the floor is offered on the date just asked, once, saying the rest stays overdue. Refusing it is a flat refusal that uses an attempt. Attempt 1 is then the floor on the last business day of this week, and attempt 2 (late band) is the floor on the deadline.
Floor names: 'minimum payment' for the credit card and 'instalment' for the loans, from the account field names (minimum_payment / instalment_amount).
Brief A never uses add_note: notes are disabled and every note code is empty.
Days late outside 1 to 45: the brief says the bank calls only 1 to 45; no rule is given, so bands_outside is omitted (engine default).
after_promise.ask_anything_else kept at default true; rule 36 (changes go through the mobile app) is used in promise_change.
If a transfer follows a recorded promise, the call closes as transferred with that transfer's reason (rule 46); the transfer events carry these codes.
The human queue is 'general' (rule 42 and the transfer_to_agent enum).
Rule 1 requires saying the call is recorded; it is phrased as 'We record this call.'
The callback_requested event is not defined because the brief does not cover a verified customer asking for a callback.
Event notes are empty strings because Brief A never calls add_note; the API enum is listed in code_tables.note for reference only.
